forgiven.line: Don’t you know you have to forgive that you may be forgiven?
stanza: My sister’s a Queen, she ain't no concubine
Don’t call my sister no concubine, she is the Mother of Creation
Who are you? Who are you to call her a concubine?
Don’t you know you have to forgive that you may be forgiven?
Dear lover forgiven
My love is driven by rage
Oh, I should just leave you
Instead of deceive you
But I don't
All is forgiven
Alright, you are forgiven

forgiven.line: I laughed and said I'll be forgiven
stanza: I was taking my pride in the pleasures I'd known
I laughed and said I'll be forgiven
But my laughter turned round, eyes blazing, and said
"Friend, we're holding a wedding"

forgiven.line: If you think that I could be forgiven
stanza: And it's one more day up in the canyons
And it's one more night in Hollywood
If you think that I could be forgiven
I wish you would
With no explanations
Life can be sweet
Have no expectations
And please just stay with me
With all that were given
We have all that we need
A life that's worth livin'
Is just some mouth to feed

given.line: Take it with the love it's given
given.linePrev: Don't you, flan in the face
given.lineNext: Take it with a pinch of salt

given.line: Life's no picnic, that's a given
stanza: When I was your age I was just like you
And just look at me now, I'm sure you do
But your grandfather was just as bad
And you should have heard him trash his dad
Life's no picnic, that's a given
My mom's mom died when my mom was seven
My mom's father was a tragic guy
But he was so distant that nobody knows why
Now, your mother's family, you know them
Each and every one a gem
Each and every one a gem
We have been given
The same fortune cookies
You and I and
All of our progenies

given.line: He says the choices were given
stanza: Except we keep coming back
To this meaning that I lack
He says the choices were given
Now you must live them
Or just not live
